messages:
olivia: FYI mkdocs linkcheck failed on the deploy guide: /guides/deploy#start-server is 404ing in CI. seems like an anchor mismatch after the mdx indentation change
kevin: can you paste the heading block and the failing link?
olivia: sure — the heading in question was wrapped with an indented code sample above it, which looks like this:
```
    ```bash
    npm run start
    ```

    ## Start Server  
    Run `npm run start` to boot the service.
```

olivia: note the trailing two spaces after the heading. suspect link slug got trimmed differently between dev and CI
jessica: ah yeah trailing spaces can cause slug oddities in our mkdocs slugify config. `mkdocs-material` vs our slugify plugin disagree sometimes :/
docs-bot: CI Linkcheck failed for branch `fix/docs/deploy-anchor`
  - file: docs/guides/deploy.md
  - broken link: /guides/deploy#start-server
  - job: docs-linkcheck (exit 1)

ian: I can do a minimal PR: remove trailing spaces on the heading, and add an explicit id to be safe. will also add a tiny test to linkcheck fixtures
kevin: please also add a comment in the markdown explaining the explicit id so next person knows why it's there. short inline comment like `<!-- explicit id: start-server -->` is fine
ian: ack. patch opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6742 — diff shows heading change + explicit id
sam: will backcompat break permalinks? some customers might link to `#start-server` already
jessica: explicit id keeps the old slug; removing trailing spaces avoids the two-tool mismatch. should be safe. also adding a redirect is overkill here
ian: added test under tests/fixtures/linkcheck/deploy_links.yaml to assert `/guides/deploy#start-server` resolves
docs-bot: Running docs-linkcheck on PR 6742...
docs-bot: docs-linkcheck: ✅ passed (0 broken links)
kevin: nice. can we also add a quick note to the docs CONTRIBUTING.md about not trailing spaces on headings? simple bullet under "writing docs"
olivia: done — pushed a tiny CONTRIBUTING update in the same PR
ian: merging once CI is green for the rest of the jobs
deploy-bot: docs deploy preview available at https://deploy-preview-6742--docs.redwood-inference.com/guides/deploy#start-server :tada:
kevin: awesome — thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
olivia: thanks all, closing the loop on the original failure
